summary: Swift FractalClient can load committed scenario indexes and slices with pointer-directed millisecond rebasing, including lowercase RFC 3339 separators, preserving opaque content and future conversation entries. Shared-vector and filesystem-enumerating tests cover scenario wire decoding and enforce strict object keys and known enum cases for strict slices.

replay.detail: The native reader loads committed values only; it does not replay application events or generate seeded conversation history.

schema.detail: No database, generated wire model, or shared fixture format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention, or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds a local Swift scenario reader API. Existing client networking and app behavior are unchanged. Only declared timestamp pointers shift; future conversation entry types remain opaque and recognized malformed entries still fail decoding.

downtime.detail: No service deployment or outage is required.

manual.detail: No operator action. Native scenario consumers supply the shared fixture directory and optionally pin the reader clock.

recovery.detail: The reader changes no durable state.
